llm.summary: The skill mostly does what it claims, but it declares an unnecessary unpinned global npm install that can run code during installation.

dimensions.detail: Local file reads and writes, Node subprocess calls, and optional headless Chrome rendering are purpose-aligned for generating and previewing decks, but preview rendering should be limited to trusted/generated HTML.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md declares `npm install -g @aspect-ratio/preview-renderer` without a pinned version, lockfile, or clear use in the inspected scripts, creating avoidable mutable global install risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are largely Chinese and generated pages hardcode zh-CN locale, which may surprise non-Chinese users but does not show hidden authority or security bypass behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The global npm dependency persists outside the skill workspace and is broader than the local script-based workflow appears to require.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact coherently supports generating single-file HTML slide decks, using local Node scripts, theme references, structured content, and optional preview rendering.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review or remove the global npm dependency before installing. If you use the preview renderer, render only HTML produced by the skill or otherwise trusted content, and choose output paths carefully because the scripts create or overwrite files.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced markdown and script files are present and inspectable; modular reference loading appears to be token-saving documentation structure, not artifact-backed evasion.
[SQP-3] unexpected: Chinese-only guidance and hardcoded zh-CN locale are real usability and locale-scope notes, but they do not by themselves create hidden access, exfiltration, or destructive behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: The file writes and Chrome subprocess are disclosed through runnable commands and are expected for HTML and PNG generation, though overwrite prompts and clearer rendering warnings would improve transparency.
[T08] unexpected: The unpinned global npm dependency is accepted as a material concern because it is mutable, installs globally, and was not referenced by the inspected execution path.
